tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground and full-bleed backgrounds. Carbon black in dark, warm paper in light.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Panels and cards that sit on surface-000.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Inset wells inside a panel: chart backgrounds, progress tracks, bar tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers, 1px. Also the track outline stroke.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-000, 100 and 200. 15:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions, nav links. At least 6:1 on surface-000 in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Signal red. Fills only: primary buttons, live dots, active bars, the lap line. The one bold color on any screen.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for brand surfaces.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Red used as TEXT (eyebrows, accent words). Passes 4.5:1 on surface-000 and surface-100 where brand does not.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a brand fill. Near-black, never white.

tokens.name: data-a
tokens.usage: First data series and Driver A traces.

tokens.name: data-b
tokens.usage: Second data series and Driver B traces. Differs from data-a in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: compound-soft
tokens.usage: Soft tyre stints.

tokens.name: compound-medium
tokens.usage: Medium tyre stints.

tokens.name: compound-hard
tokens.usage: Hard tyre stints.

tokens.name: light-off
tokens.usage: An unlit start light.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headlines and the closing call to action.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Hero supporting paragraph. Keep to about 520px wide.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text and card copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, chart captions and legends. Always uppercase.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Status lines, progress readouts and percentages. Use tabular numerals.

spacing.note: 8px base with a 4px half step. Page gutters are 80px at desktop.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text hairline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside labels and legends.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its bar, logo and wordmark.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default inline gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card grid gap, panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, stack gap in a hero.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a section headline and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter and background grid pitch.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Stint segments and bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inset wells inside a panel.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The closing call-to-action band and the start-lights housing.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and tags.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The floating hero panel. Use once per screen.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Hover glow under a primary button.
